title: ContractFixture
description: An M0 contract fixture's golden (docs/design/m0/11 "M0 exercises real validators"): the invariant it targets, the (outcome, reason) sequence its steps must yield through the real components, and the named mutation that must turn it red. adc dev fixtures --contract runs it; make fixtures-contract checks the mutation.

name.description: The fixture's name: its golden file's name and its registered runner.

invariant.description: The invariant the fixture targets, in one sentence.

expected.description: One (outcome, reason) per step, in order, each a pair a writer may emit (02). A command the component admits, applied or replayed, is empty/completed_clean; a component that returns its own result triple is expected with that triple's outcome and reason.

mutation.description: The named mutation (internal/mutation) that must turn the fixture red.
